2750.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Compromised PyPI Package: mrmustard 0.7.4 Steals SSH, Cloud, and Kubernetes Cred
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/usr/bin/env", "/home/runner/.cache/.tf_cache/hw_probe.pyc", "/dev/null") or FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2750.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Compromised PyPI Package: mrmustard 0.7.4 Steals SSH, Cloud, and Kubernetes Cred ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("__init__.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/usr/bin/env*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/home/runner/.cache/.tf_cache/hw_probe.pyc*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("__init__.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

| extend SecretStore = case(FolderPath has "/.ssh", "ssh", FolderPath has "/.aws", "aws", FolderPath has "/.kube", "kube", "")

id: 6f1e9c2a-7b3d-4e88-9a11-2c4d5e6f7a8b
description: Detects a Node.js runtime spawning a command interpreter, consistent with @prompty/core Nunjucks SSTI reaching child_process.execSync (GHSA-w28w-gp39-m4p6).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-w28w-gp39-m4p6
  - https://github.com/swisskyrepo/PayloadsAllTheThings/blob/master/Server%20Side%20Template%20Injection/JavaScript.md
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/27
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.t1059.004
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '/node'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/d /s /c'
      - '/c '
      - ' -c '
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd
level: medium
2774.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t allow_old_summaries=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("node.exe","node") AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","dash","zsh")) AND (Processes.process="*/d /s /c*" OR Processes.process="*/c *" OR Processes.process="* -c *") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2774.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE) @Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\Pwsh.exe)
2774.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^node(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$|\/(sh|bash|dash|zsh)$/i
| regex("(/d /s /c|/c | -c )", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2830.sent:
// One HMAC signature reused across >1 (taskID,artifactName) tuple on the Gitea V4 artifact handlers = CVE-2026-58426 boundary-shift forgery.
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where RequestURL has_any ("DownloadArtifact","UploadArtifact")
| where RequestURL has "sig="
| extend Sig = extract(@"[?&]sig=([^&]+)", 1, RequestURL)
| extend TaskID = extract(@"[?&]taskID=([^&]+)", 1, RequestURL)
| extend ArtifactName = extract(@"[?&]artifactName=([^&]+)", 1, RequestURL)
| where isnotempty(Sig)
| extend Tuple = strcat(TaskID, "|", ArtifactName)
| summarize DistinctTuples = dcount(Tuple), Tuples = make_set(Tuple, 10), Methods = make_set(RequestMethod, 5), SrcIPs = make_set(SourceIP, 10), Requests = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Sig, DestinationHostName
| where DistinctTuples > 1   // a valid sig should only ever pair with one fixed tuple
